notes.title: doubling the discount
notes.notes: For the remainder of the summer sale, Alien Bob will be available at half price!

notes.title: Summer Sale Discount!
notes.notes: Good news! The best time of year for gamers everywhere is here! The Steam summer sale has started and for the next two weeks, you can pick up Alien Bob at a 25% discount! To celebrate, we even added a new, much larger and far more challenging level to the end of the game! We hope you enjoy it and make the most of the summer sale! Happy gaming!

notes.title: New Level!
notes.notes: To mark the Summer Sale, we have added a new, exceptionally challenging level at roughly three to four times the size (and if we are honest... probably also complexity), of any other level previously in the game! We hope you enjoy it!

notes.title: Cancelling the cancellation!
notes.notes: So we've looked into it and Alien Bob isn't going anywhere (although he may change his name to Ron...). Regardless of his name though, we will be discounting the game for the summer sale and adding new levels in a large update, on or before the 27th!! The game is about to get quite a bit longer and a little bit more challenging. Thank you to all those who have already purchased the game and we hope you enjoy what we have in store.

notes.title: Cancellation! :(
notes.notes:
It saddens us to say, but unfortunately Alien Bob's journey has to come to an end. We have enjoyed developing it and are so SO grateful to those of you who chose to buy the game and support our company. We have recently become aware of potential difficulties involving the game's copyright and feel our best course of action is to remove it from the store. 

Thank you again for supporting us and don't worry. We will be back in the future with bigger and higher quality games, as was always our plan.
